Great game! 

This is possibly the best game you can get for your money when it comes to drifting.
There's a lot of different cars, a lot of different tuning options and more.

I personally play this game on keyboard, and using a wheel is recommended for the best possible experience!
However, the game is great even if you are playing with a keyboard or a controller.

If you enjoy drifting or car games in general, this game is 100% worth the money.
